topics.title: Plan and Product Provisions
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to describe plan provisions typically offered under short duration contracts (medical, dental, vision, prescription drug, group life).

outcomes.text: Describe typical organizations offering these contracts
Describe each of the contracts listed above
Evaluate the potential moral hazard and financial and legal risks associated with each type of contract
Describe the product development process including risks and opportunities to be considered during the process

topics.title: Manual Rates
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to calculate and recommend a manual rate for each of the contracts described in Learning Objective 1.

outcomes.text: Identify and evaluate sources of data needed for pricing, including the quality, appropriateness, and limitations of each data source
Develop a medical cost trend experience analysis
Calculate and recommend a manual rate (includes developing a base rate and applying a rating manual)
Identify critical metrics to evaluate actual vs. expected results
Apply actuarial best practices in evaluating and projecting claim data

topics.title: Underwriting and Funding
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to apply principles of pricing, risk assessment, and funding to an underwriting situation.

outcomes.text: Understand the risks and opportunities associated with a given contract, eligibility requirement, or funding mechanism
Understand, evaluate, and apply risk assessment mechanisms
Recommend strategies for appropriately pricing, underwriting, and funding case-specific risks
Describe and apply approaches to claim credibility and pooling
Apply Total Risk Analysis (TRA) strategies to case-specific pricing
